facts.fact: The National AI Strategy lists the Data Protection Act, 2012 (Act 843) among existing data protection policies and laws whose implementation is to be reviewed and completed, treating it as current law; the document gives no date for the statement beyond its December 2025 publication.

systems.owner: Ministry of Communication, Digital Technology and Innovations
systems.tiers: national; strategy proposes regional offices in all 16 regions

systems.system: Proposed Data Protection Authority (upgrade of the DPC)

note: Strategy of December 2025 states the strategy proposes enabling legislation to upgrade the DPC to an Authority with regional offices (authority-row matter, announced, not a general-law fact); it states nothing on Act 843's regulations or application.
